name: lw_29119
statement: {a b c : ℝ} (ha : a ≥ 0) (hb : b ≥ 0) (hc : c ≥ 0) (hab : a ≥ b) (hbc : b ≥ c) (hca : c ≥ a) : a^4 + b^4 + c^4 + a * b * c * (a + b + c) ≥ a^3 * (b + c) + b^3 * (c + a) + c^3 * (a + b)
closed: ∀ {a b c : ℝ} (ha : a ≥ 0) (hb : b ≥ 0) (hc : c ≥ 0) (hab : a ≥ b) (hbc : b ≥ c) (hca : c ≥ a), a^4 + b^4 + c^4 + a * b * c * (a + b + c) ≥ a^3 * (b + c) + b^3 * (c + a) + c^3 * (a + b)
informal: The second part is equivalent to Schur inequality. \n $ a^4+b^4+c^4+abc(a+b+c) \ge a^3(b+c)+b^3(c+a)+c^3(a+b).$
